value.text: I see connect_services.go has adapter methods wrapping the gRPC implementation into Connect-style signatures, starting around the MemoService section. I should verify there's no separate native gRPC server being instantiated elsewhere.

There's no direct grpc.NewServer call, so the two exposed protocols are HTTP/REST via grpc-gateway and Connect RPC, both registered in v1.go. I'm noting the REST registration happens in v1.go alongside the generated gateway file, and now tracing where Connect RPC's registration lives in the same router directory.

The Connect handler wraps in connect_services.go, with the generated code in the connect package, mounted back in v1.go. Now I want to double-check that the gateway actually routes everything under /api/v1/.

q19.

MemoService is exposed over **gRPC-Gateway REST/HTTP-JSON** and **Connect RPC** (Connect/gRPC-web style POST endpoints). There is no plain gRPC listener — `grpc.NewServer` appears nowhere in the repo, so the generated `RegisterMemoServiceServer` in `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service_grpc.pb.go` is never called; the service struct only embeds `UnimplementedMemoServiceServer` so its gRPC method set can be reused by both HTTP paths.

- **gRPC-Gateway (REST / HTTP-JSON) — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`**: `RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s)` at line 108 registers the memo methods directly onto the grpc-gateway `ServeMux` (in-process, no client conn), and that mux is mounted on Echo at `/api/v1/*` and `/file/*` (lines 126–129). The generated routing table it uses lives in `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go`.

```108:110:/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go
	if err := v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s); err != nil {
		return err
	}
```

- **Connect RPC — `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go`**: `apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler(s, opts...)` at line 40 produces the path and handler that get mounted on a `http.ServeMux`; the wrapping of the gRPC methods into Connect request/response envelopes (and gRPC-status-to-Connect-code conversion) is in `ConnectServiceHandler` methods in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` (MemoService block starts at line 304), against the generated handler in `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go`.

```40:40:/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go
		wrap(apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler(s, opts...)),
```

Both are then attached to the same Echo server in `RegisterGateway` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`, with the Connect mux served under the `/memos.api.v1.*` prefix (line 144). Auth is shared through one `Authorizer`, applied as grpc-gateway middleware for the REST path and as `NewAuthInterceptor` for the Connect path.
